unit.why: An anecdote about 'the Sabba' (likely the Shpoler Zeide) playing nuts with children while performing yihudim; a visiting tzaddik explains he is working on rain, and rain clouds gather. A depiction of his ecstatic Sabbath dancing follows.
unit.boundary_note: opens with 'גם', so it likely continues a series of praises of the same figure from an earlier division

stories.start_quote: גם היה דרכו בקודש לשחק עם תינוקות
stories.end_quote: לדלג על ההרים ולעוף בשמים כו' וד״ל
stories.summary_en: The Sabba performs awesome yihudim while playing nuts with small children. A visiting tzaddik explains to onlookers that he is acting to end a drought and predicts clouds within the hour, which comes true. The text adds that his ecstatic Sabbath and holiday dancing moved every viewer to repentance.
